voice: Diegetic guestbook established in second-person narration listing attendees and reflecting Laura's signature.

entries.text: A tall, imposing gentleman guards the door in a severe military uniform. A leather-bound register rests on the podium beside him.
You scan the guestbook and make note of several important-sounding names of some guests you might encounter this evening.
Your name has now been immortalized into the guestbook.
Taking up the pen, you sign the guestbook with a flourish.
As much as you would like to believe, adding your name to the register a second time won't make you twice as popular.
